title: Multi-omics single-cell data integration and regulatory inference with graph-linked embedding
training_information: Unpaired assay matrices plus signed, weighted feature-guidance graph; optional additional regulatory evidence.
objective: Modality VAEs, guidance-graph reconstruction and weighted adversarial alignment.
target: Joint cell/feature embeddings and regulatory scores; TF networks additionally combine binding evidence and SCENIC.
training_pairing: Unpaired in core study; extensions can use paired supervision.
validation_information: Paired-cell alignment, paired correlations, pcHi-C/eQTL and curated TF-network evidence.
theorem_applicability: Fixed guidance and identical full assay laws give identical objectives; no general causal-DAG identification theorem found in inspected methods.
positive_restrictions: Shared-state generative model and informative biological feature graph can support regulatory prediction.
evidence_locator: Original Methods: The GLUE framework; Weighted adversarial alignment; Results: Integrative regulatory inference; Discussion.
caveat: Do not dismiss reported regulatory validation; symmetric feature scores alone do not determine causal direction.

title: scConfluence: single-cell diagonal integration with regularized Inverse Optimal Transport on weakly connected features
training_information: Separate matrices and annotations converting some features to a common space; batch labels when available.
objective: Stochastic autoencoder reconstruction, partial-cost-plan inverse OT and latent unbalanced Sinkhorn.
target: Biological cell alignment, clustering and feature imputation.
training_pairing: No cell pairs required.
validation_information: Cell labels and pairing used in evaluation; original task embeds the supplied dataset.
theorem_applicability: The rIOT lemma rewrites an optimization objective for a given plan; it does not identify a biological causal graph.
positive_restrictions: Informative connected features and partial population overlap guide matching.
evidence_locator: Methods: scConfluence, Eqs.7–13; Training details; Outputs.
caveat: Paper squared IOT distance differs from pinned native Euclidean distance; local pilot also changes inputs/evaluation.

title: scMRDR: A Scalable and Flexible Framework for Unpaired Single-Cell Multi-Omics Data Integration
version: NeurIPS 2025 proceedings; inspected author manuscript arXiv v2, 2026-01-17
training_information: Unpaired gene-aligned matrices, activity conversion, feature masks and optional batch covariates; no cell-type labels.
objective: Shared/specific beta-VAE, masked ZINB reconstruction, adversarial modality loss and within-assay isometry.
target: Cell-type conservation, modality/batch mixing, spatial imputation.
training_pairing: No pairs required; shared feature semantics remain an input.
validation_information: Annotated public benchmarks and scIB metrics; labels excluded from training.
theorem_applicability: Section 2 explicitly acknowledges latent nonidentifiability; no causal-identification theorem found in inspected methods.
positive_restrictions: Independent shared/specific latent subspaces and gene-level measurement model with geometry regularization.
caveat: 'No prior' does not mean no gene correspondence or no modeling restrictions. The inspected v2 is later than the 2025 proceedings.
status: peer-reviewed conference proceedings; inspected arXiv revision

title: SCOT: Single-Cell Multi-Omics Alignment with Optimal Transport
training_information: Separate matrices; within-assay kNN graph distances; no feature or cell correspondences required.
objective: Entropically regularized GW coupling followed by barycentric projection.
target: Probabilistic cell correspondence and aligned measurements.
training_pairing: Unpaired core fit; self-tuning uses GW cost.
validation_information: Simulation truth and coassays; paper also compares correspondence-based parameter selection.
theorem_applicability: GW/OT optimization theory does not identify a biological residual coupling; observed-law counterexamples remain applicable.
positive_restrictions: Assumes shared biology expressed in sufficiently comparable geometry.
evidence_locator: §2.1–2.4; Algorithm 1; real-data evaluation.
caveat: Unsupervised self-tuning is a heuristic, not a causal-identification theorem.

title: SCOTv2: Single-Cell Multiomic Alignment with Disproportionate Cell-Type Representation
training_information: Separate assay geometry; anchor modality for multiple assays; no required cross-assay feature matches.
objective: Unbalanced GW relaxes mass constraints; barycentric mapping/coembedding.
target: Alignment with unequal cell-type proportions and multiple modalities.
training_pairing: Unpaired fit and self-tuning variant.
validation_information: Coassays and noncoassays with natural/simulated imbalance; cell labels assess accuracy.
theorem_applicability: Relaxing marginal mass constraints handles imbalance but does not observe cross-assay residual dependence.
positive_restrictions: Shared cell types/lineages and informative within-assay geometry.
evidence_locator: Introduction; §2 Methods; self-tuning and noncoassay evaluations.
caveat: Explicitly distinguishes noncoassay sampling from coassay benchmarks; retain that positive advance.

title: Manifold alignment for heterogeneous single-cell multi-omics data integration using Pamona
training_information: Within-assay geodesic distances and shared mass estimate; optional cell-type or cell-pair prior.
objective: Partial entropic GW with virtual cells, then geometry-preserving embedding.
target: Shared and assay-specific populations and probabilistic coupling.
training_pairing: Unpaired default; supervised extension supported.
validation_information: Simulations/coassays; heterogeneous PBMC analysis incorporates cell-type annotations.
theorem_applicability: Partial-transport construction is not a theorem identifying biological causal edges.
positive_restrictions: Comparable partial manifolds; known labels/pairs reduce alignment ambiguity.
evidence_locator: §2.1–2.2; §3.5; Discussion.
caveat: Best label-assisted examples cannot be treated as unsupervised evidence.

publication_dates.preferred_year_basis: journal issue year, matching publisher citation
publication_dates.note: Crossref online publication year 2021 and issue year 2022 are both correct; they identify the same article.

title: Unsupervised topological alignment for single-cell multi-omics integration
training_information: Separate feature matrices without cell or feature links; within-assay geodesic distances.
objective: Soft distance-matrix matching with global scale, then coupled t-SNE-like embedding.
target: Cell alignment and shared embedding.
training_pairing: Unpaired core; known matches can constrain the matching matrix.
validation_information: Simulations and coassayed sc-GEM/scNMT benchmarks.
theorem_applicability: Optimization claims concern matching; Discussion explicitly recognizes indistinguishable symmetric structures.
positive_restrictions: Similar intrinsic topology, sufficiently asymmetric informative geometry.
evidence_locator: Methods A1–A3; Discussion limitations.
caveat: Reported biological asymmetry can help alignment; it is not a general residual-copula identification condition.

title: Jointly Embedding Multiple Single-Cell Omics Measurements
training_information: Separate within-domain kernels; no known cell/feature correspondences.
objective: MMD between latent distributions plus distortion and projection penalties.
target: Shared manifold embedding.
training_pairing: Unpaired fitting.
validation_information: Synthetic manifolds and 61 coassayed methylation/expression cells.
theorem_applicability: Representer theorem supports kernel parameterization; no biological causal-identification theorem located in inspected methods.
positive_restrictions: Shared manifold and similar latent point distributions with enough structure to align.
evidence_locator: Methods: unsupervised manifold alignment, MMD-MA algorithm, optimization; Discussion.
caveat: Nonconvex optimization and matching ambiguity are distinct limitations.

title: Unsupervised manifold alignment for single-cell multi-omics data
training_information: Separate measurements; extends MMD-MA GPU implementation and bandwidth selection.
objective: Inherited MMD, distortion and projection objective.
target: Practical alignment of approximately 2,000-cell coassays.
training_pairing: Core alignment does not require correspondence.
validation_information: Coassayed RNA/accessibility datasets and parameter comparisons.
theorem_applicability: No causal-theorem conclusion drawn from abstract/limited indexed method excerpts.
positive_restrictions: Inherited shared-manifold premise; demonstrated practical scaling.
evidence_locator: Abstract and indexed §2.6–2.7 excerpts; original 2019 methods separately inspected.
caveat: Full-text browser blocked and Europe PMC XML failed; not a complete methods audit.

title: MATCHER: manifold alignment reveals correspondence between single cell transcriptome and epigenome dynamics
training_information: Separate matrices, biological orientation prior, same population/process/cell type.
objective: GPLVM pseudotime followed by monotone quantile warping to common master time.
target: State correspondence, generated profiles and cross-modal correlations.
training_pairing: Unpaired mode; separate paired shared-GPLVM extension.
validation_information: scM&T-seq/sc-GEM pairs withheld for validation; independent-lab RNA comparison.
theorem_applicability: Restricted monotone state completion can succeed; no unrestricted residual-coupling or causal-DAG identification follows.
positive_restrictions: One-dimensional monotone process; common sampling distribution; correct orientation supplied biologically.
evidence_locator: Overview assumptions; correlation evaluation; Methods warping; paired extension.
caveat: Paper explicitly says correct orientation cannot be inferred from data alone.

title: Bi-order multimodal integration of single-cell data
training_information: Unpaired matrices plus initial feature-conversion/fusion matrix, such as gene activity.
objective: Iterative cell- and feature-level CCA with regularization toward initial conversion.
target: Coembedding, fusion matrix, imputation and association networks.
training_pairing: No cell pairs required for fitting.
validation_information: Coassayed retina/bone marrow and predicted-profile correlations.
theorem_applicability: Fixed-point/local-convergence claim is computational, not causal identification.
positive_restrictions: Useful initial feature correspondence and shared correlated structure.
evidence_locator: Methods: initializing feature matching, Bi-CCA, parameter optimization, protein–gene networks.
caveat: Protein–gene networks use correlations in imputed profiles; no directed intervention claim established.

title: scDART: integrating unmatched scRNA-seq and scATAC-seq data and learning cross-modality relationship simultaneously
training_information: Separate RNA/ATAC matrices and genomic gene-activity prior; optional root/cell anchors.
objective: Neural activity mapping, diffusion-distance preservation, MMD alignment and prior sparsity.
target: Integrated trajectories and nonlinear accessibility-to-expression mapping.
training_pairing: Unpaired core; scDART-anchor uses known correspondences.
validation_information: Unmatched datasets, coassays and simulated activity functions.
theorem_applicability: A learned regulatory mapping is model-dependent; no general causal-identification theorem located in inspected methods.
positive_restrictions: Similar trajectories; prior zeros assumed correct and prior ones may be false positives.
evidence_locator: Methods: prior GAM, trajectory preservation, MMD, anchors; Discussion.
caveat: Paper acknowledges imperfect prediction and recommends paired data for stronger prediction when available.

title: scJoint integrates atlas-scale single-cell RNA-seq and ATAC-seq data with transfer learning
training_information: Annotated RNA and unlabeled ATAC collections.
objective: Neural joint training of labeled/unlabeled observations; detailed losses not independently audited here.
target: Cell-type label transfer and joint visualization.
training_pairing: Cell pairs not required; RNA labels are supervision.
validation_information: Atlases, ASAP-seq and CITE-seq label accuracy.
theorem_applicability: No causal-identification conclusion drawn from abstract-only evidence.
positive_restrictions: Informative annotated reference and transferable cell identities.
evidence_locator: PubMed primary abstract and bibliographic record.
caveat: Original full-text retrieval blocked; cannot classify this as wholly unsupervised or claim a full objective audit.

title: sciCAN: single-cell chromatin accessibility and gene expression data integration via cycle-consistent adversarial network
training_information: Gene-aligned expression/accessibility inputs; augmented within-assay cells; no cell-type labels required.
objective: Noise-contrastive representation, modality adversary, generated-accessibility adversary and latent cycle loss.
target: Coembedding, label transfer, trajectories and activity–expression analyses.
training_pairing: Unpaired integration.
validation_information: Five datasets; Multiome hematopoietic hierarchy; CRISPR examples are downstream applications.
theorem_applicability: Cycle consistency constrains a chosen mapping; does not identify unrestricted biological residual coupling.
positive_restrictions: Comparable shared features and coherent latent mapping.
evidence_locator: Methods: Representation learning, Domain adaptation, Cycle-consistent network; Results.
caveat: Perturbation applications must not be treated as information available in our baseline.

title: scTopoGAN: unsupervised manifold alignment of single-cell data
training_information: Separate matrices, no overlapping cells/features or training labels required.
objective: Topology-preserving autoencoders; select GAN alignments by persistent-pairing distortion.
target: Cell-type/trajectory-aligned manifolds.
training_pairing: Unpaired fitting; labels evaluated afterward.
validation_information: PBMC, bone marrow, scGEM cell-type matching.
theorem_applicability: Topology preservation selects mappings; no general causal-identification theorem located in inspected methods.
positive_restrictions: Modalities share sufficiently similar manifold topology.
evidence_locator: §2.1.1–2.1.2; Discussion.
caveat: Authors explicitly acknowledge imperfect shared-manifold assumption and difficulty without linking ground truth.

title: SCIM: universal single-cell matching with unpaired feature sets
training_information: Separate matrices, no feature matches; censored cell labels orient the latent space.
objective: Reconstruction plus adversarial modality alignment; minimum-cost matching with null nodes.
target: Sibling-cell matching across technologies.
training_pairing: No physical cell pairs required; semisupervised label information used.
validation_information: Simulated pseudotime and real RNA/CyTOF cell-type concordance.
theorem_applicability: Paper explicitly gives reversed-trajectory alignment ambiguity; labels address orientation, not unrestricted residual causality.
positive_restrictions: Common low-dimensional structure, approximately shared population distribution and orientation supervision.
evidence_locator: §2.1 The orientation of latent space; §2.2; matching evaluation.
caveat: Reported matching accuracy is mainly cell-type agreement, not exact same-cell causal recovery.

title: MultiMAP: dimensionality reduction and integration of multimodal data
training_information: Full assay features plus shared-feature spaces/activity conversions; optional supplied correspondence in synthetic example.
objective: Construct multimodal fuzzy neighborhood graph and minimize embedding cross-entropy.
target: Integrated embedding/graph, clustering and trajectory comparisons.
training_pairing: Unpaired biological integration; synthetic Swiss-roll example supplies 1% manifold positions.
validation_information: Cell annotations, multiome pairing and structure metrics.
theorem_applicability: Riemannian/topological construction does not establish unrestricted causal-DAG identification.
positive_restrictions: Uniformity on a shared latent manifold and informative shared-feature neighborhoods.
evidence_locator: Methods MultiMAP; framework; synthetic-data description.
caveat: Using unshared features does not eliminate reliance on shared-feature information.

title: SCOT+: a comprehensive software suite for single-cell alignment using optimal transport
family: Unified GW, COOT and augmented GW transport
training_information: Separate matrices/geometry; optional known cell/feature supervision costs.
objective: Balanced/unbalanced cell and feature couplings with entropy and marginal penalties.
target: Cell/feature alignment and imputed coassay-like data.
training_pairing: Unsupervised and supervised configurations explicitly available.
validation_information: Balanced/imbalanced datasets and feature-supervised cross-species alignment.
theorem_applicability: Optimization formulations and feature couplings are not a causal-identification guarantee; observed-law argument applies to unsupervised modes.
positive_restrictions: Comparable geometry/features; reliable homolog or cell-label supervision improves specific matching.
evidence_locator: §2.1–2.4; §3.5; Discussion.
caveat: Discussion proposes future GRN applications; it does not establish that generated coassays retain causal truth.

title: BiCLUM: Bilateral contrastive learning for unpaired single-cell multi-omics integration
training_information: Gene activity or gene–protein correspondence; MNN pseudo-cell pairs and known feature pairs.
objective: Cell/feature autoencoder reconstruction plus bilateral InfoNCE.
target: Coembedding, label transfer and biological feature analyses.
training_pairing: No true cell pairs required; constructed MNN pairs train alignment.
validation_information: Paired and unpaired benchmarks, FOSCTTM and cell-type metrics.
theorem_applicability: Constructed positives are input-derived alignment choices, not observations of the missing residual joint.
positive_restrictions: Reliable converted features/MNN anchors and valid gene–protein mappings.
evidence_locator: Materials and methods, Steps 1–3; paired/unpaired benchmark sections.
caveat: PCA feeds encoders but MNNs use shared original feature space; distinguish both from biological pairing.

title: Integration of single-cell multi-omics data by regression analysis on unpaired observations
training_information: Unpaired RNA/ATAC covariance, genomic distances, cis support and initialization.
objective: Fit expression covariance with beta-transformed accessibility covariance; distance penalty and imputation refinement.
target: Cis-regulatory coefficients and predicted expression.
training_pairing: No paired observations required to fit.
validation_information: Simulations, multiome prediction and coembedding; some truth uses imputed data.
theorem_applicability: Positive restricted-model evidence; no coefficient-uniqueness/causal-identification theorem located in inspected methods.
positive_restrictions: Linear accessibility-to-expression model; conditionally independent gene errors; hard cis zeros beyond 200 kb.
evidence_locator: Methods UnpairReg model, Eqs.1–3; Algorithm; Discussion limitations.
caveat: Covariance factorization can be ambiguous; assumptions may fail for TF effects independent of accessibility.

title: Single-cell multi-omics integration for unpaired data by a siamese network with graph-based contrastive loss
training_information: Paired multiome/CITE-seq reference cells and cell-type labels; unpaired target inputs after training.
objective: Siamese true-pair contrastive loss, graph-based negative margins and cell-type classification.
target: Unpaired-target coembedding and smoothed mini-bulk regulatory associations.
training_pairing: Paired supervised training is required by the described model.
validation_information: Held-out datasets and pcHi-C support for inferred associations.
theorem_applicability: Outside the strict no-paired-reference baseline; cannot apply the same observed-law theorem without including training reference information.
positive_restrictions: Transferable paired labeled reference.
evidence_locator: Results overview; Methods Siamese network, margin, Training process.
caveat: Title's 'unpaired' describes target application, not the complete training information.

title: An interpretable Graph-Regularized Optimal Transport Framework for Diagonal Single-Cell Integrative Analysis
training_information: Within-assay kernels and kNN geometry; separate supervised/unsupervised benchmark settings.
objective: Latent Sinkhorn alignment, graph Laplacian smoothness and RKHS projection constraints.
target: Embedding, co-clustering and feature-importance/regulatory candidates.
training_pairing: Unsupervised mode exists; partial-label evaluation distinguished.
validation_information: Simulations and coassays; label transfer, FOSCTTM and biological enrichment.
theorem_applicability: Representer theorem concerns kernel representation, not identification of the biological joint or causal graph.
positive_restrictions: Shared manifold/lineage geometry; optional supervision; motif and proximity evidence for regulatory interpretation.
evidence_locator: Methods Problem formulation through GROTIA algorithm; interpretability; Results semi/unsupervised settings.
caveat: Embedding derivatives and motif/proximity-supported pairs are not intervention-effect estimates.

title: A unified computational framework for single-cell data integration with optimal transport
family: Coupled variational autoencoding and unbalanced optimal transport
training_information: Unpaired matrices with common and assay-specific variable genes; chromatin gene-activity conversion supplies feature correspondence.
objective: Coupled-VAE ELBO plus minibatch unbalanced OT between Gaussian latent posteriors.
target: Integrated cell embeddings, probabilistic transport and cross-dataset imputation.
training_pairing: Core RNA/ATAC study hides pairs; optional annotations, known correspondence and sample weights are supported.
validation_information: Paired PBMC pairs reserved for evaluation, unpaired RNA/ATAC benchmarks and held-out-gene spatial imputation.
theorem_applicability: Strict convexity of the fixed-cost regularized transport subproblem selects a plan; it does not identify biological residual coupling or a causal graph.
positive_restrictions: Informative shared genes/activity conversion and common latent measurement model; relaxed marginals accommodate unmatched populations.
evidence_locator: Methods: uniPort framework Eqs.1–7; Data preprocessing; Results: uniPort integrates scATAC and scRNA data; Discussion.
caveat: Positive paired-cell and imputation results are not a general direct-edge guarantee; activity construction influences results.

title: SIMBA: single-cell embedding along with features
training_information: Cell–feature relations and optional sequence/motif annotations; unpaired RNA/ATAC graphs linked by gene-activity-derived mutual neighbors after SVD.
objective: Typed negative-sampling graph-link prediction with dot-product scores, log loss and embedding regularization.
target: Cell/feature co-embedding, markers, modality integration and candidate regulatory relationships.
training_pairing: Supports unpaired integration and paired multimodal analysis as separate graph constructions.
validation_information: Unpaired integration tested by masking dual-omics pairing; main regulator/target demonstration uses paired SHARE-seq and motif/proximity evidence.
theorem_applicability: Graph-link likelihood is conditional on constructed edges; no general causal-identification theorem found in inspected methods.
positive_restrictions: Shared activity features, motif compatibility and genomic proximity constrain predictions; paired graphs contain extra joint information.
evidence_locator: Methods: Batch correction; Multi-omics integration; Graph embeddings with type constraints; Identification of TF target genes. Results: multimodal analysis versus multi-omics integration.
caveat: Do not attribute paired regulator evidence to the unpaired-only arm, or treat computational neighbor edges as observed cell pairing.
